hero.label: Grok Imagine 1.5 preview
hero.title: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Generator
hero.description: Turn text or a small visual set into a fast video experiment. This workspace exposes 480p and 720p with five-, eight-, ten-, or fifteen-second takes and up to seven image inputs.
hero.verdict: Choose Grok Imagine 1.5 for fast concept exploration and multi-image direction. Treat the preview model as an iteration tool, then compare the strongest shot with a higher-resolution workflow if needed.
hero.source_note: Kie labels this model as a preview. This site currently limits output controls to 480p and 720p while the upstream API also documents 1080p.

sections.title: Where Grok Imagine Video 1.5 fits best
paragraphs: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 is useful early in the creative process: social concepts, storyboard motion, mood tests and quick visual combinations where iteration speed matters more than maximum resolution.
Multiple images can supply a compact visual vocabulary. Keep the set coherent—subject, environment and one material or style reference—rather than uploading seven unrelated pictures.
bullets: Use text-only mode to explore a shot before preparing references.
Use two to four related images for clearer visual direction.
Start at 480p for disposable motion tests.
Re-test a keeper in another model when final resolution or sound controls matter.

rows: Kie also documents 1080p; it is not priced or exposed here yet.
At 1080p upstream allows only one image.
Image-led requests derive composition from inputs.
The current product adapter sends no audio option.

sections.title: Use references as roles, not a collage

examples.label: Concept motion
examples.text: A translucent orange raincoat hangs in a concrete gallery. A controlled gust lifts the hem as the camera makes a slow half-circle; sharp material reflections, soft daylight, stable coat construction, quiet atmospheric motion.

examples.label: Multi-image direction
examples.text: Use the images for the same cyclist, the night market environment and the wet chrome material language. Track beside the cyclist through one turn; keep face, jacket and bicycle consistent, realistic crowd parallax, no logos or text.

sections.title: When the preview is not the final tool

rows: Both are exposed together in its adapter.
Its adapter exposes rewrite and negative prompt controls.
It separates reference-led generation from first-frame mode.

faqs.question: Is Grok Imagine Video 1.5 actually connected here?
faqs.answer: Yes. Grok Imagine Video 1.5 is preselected in the generator above. It is a preview model, and you need an account with enough credits.

faqs.question: Why is 1080p missing?
faqs.answer: Kie documents 1080p, but the current product exposes only 480p and 720p until its site credit pricing and end-to-end behavior are verified.

faqs.question: Can I use seven images?
faqs.answer: The uploader and API adapter allow up to seven public image URLs at the current product resolutions. A smaller, coherent set is usually easier to direct.

faqs.question: What does preview mean?
faqs.answer: The model name, behavior, pricing or availability may change more quickly than a stable release. Check the selected model and current controls before important work.
